description.text: Professional Overview: Pediatrics is an important secondary discipline of clinical medicine. It mainly studies the basic knowledge and skills related to the growth and development, disease prevention, disease diagnosis and treatment, and health care of children from the fetal stage to adolescence, providing high-quality medical services for children.Duration of study and Degree: The duration of study for undergraduate programs is generally five years. Upon graduation, students will be awarded a Bachelor of Medicine degree.Main disciplines: Basic medicine, clinical medicine, pediatrics, public health and preventive medicine, etc.Core courses: including Internal medicine, Surgery, Basic clinical skills, Pediatric Internal Medicine, Pediatric Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Cell Biology, Human Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Child Health Care, etc.Professional directions: Currently, under pediatrics, some branch disciplines and characteristic professional directions have also developed, such as pediatric surgery, neonatal medicine, child health care medicine, perinatal medicine, and adolescent medicine, etc.Knowledge and ability requirements: Students need to master the basic knowledge and scientific methods related to medicine, understand the anatomical and physiological characteristics of children at different stages, as well as the causes, mechanisms, clinical manifestations, diagnosis and prevention and treatment principles of common and frequently-occurring diseases. At the same time, one should possess the ability to diagnose and treat various common and frequently-occurring diseases in internal medicine, surgery and gynecology, as well as strong capabilities in the diagnosis and treatment of pediatric diseases and the screening and diagnosis of common genetic and metabolic diseases in children.Career directions: Graduates mainly work in various medical institutions, health care organizations, and medical research units, engaging in pediatric clinical medical treatment, health care, teaching or research. Some graduates will also enter schools, communities and government agencies to engage in work related to children's health. In addition, the demand for pediatric science professionals from private clinics and family doctors is also gradually increasing.Employment prospects: According to the data, the number of graduates majoring in pediatrics from regular colleges and universities across the country is 2,000 to 2,500. There is a shortage of pediatricians nationwide, and the employment situation for graduates majoring in pediatrics is good. The national graduate employment rate maintained an upward trend in 2021-2022, increasing from 81% to 93%. However, in 2023, the employment rate slightly declined compared to the previous year, ranging from 82% to 87%. Overall, the employment rate was at a medium to high level.

duration.text: The Padiatrics at Guangzhou Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. A scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport;2. The highest academic degree certificate and diploma, as well as the transcript (for those who have not yet obtained the graduation certificate or diploma, a certificate of graduation from the school is required and a copy of the graduation certificate should be provided at the time of registration).3. University transcripts and HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) transcripts;4. Two recommendation letters from associate professors or above;5. Study Plan in China. The word count requirement for applying to a master's program is over 1,000 words, and for a doctoral program, it is over 1,500 words. Applicants can write in either Chinese or English. The content includes personal study and work experience, academic research achievements, research plans and personal development goals after graduation, etc.6. A list of published papers, abstracts, or other materials that can prove one's research capabilities;7. Id photo (2-inch blue-background, bareheaded photo);8. Self-introduction video in English or Chinese (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);9. Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners"10. Applicants with work experience are requested to provide notarized work certificates. Other materials that can prove professional or personal background.11. Scanned copies of the "Economic Guarantee Letter" and its guarantee materials must be filled out in either Chinese or English.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants for a master's degree must hold a bachelor's degree in medicine or a medical-related field and be no older than 35 years old. Applicants for a doctoral degree should hold a master's degree in medicine or a medical-related field and be no older than 40 years old.2. Non-chinese citizens holding ordinary foreign passports;3. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.4. Language Requirements: The applicant's HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) score should reach level 4 or above.
